units.locator: VII. Main Directions and Tasks of Spatial Development of the Russian Federation
units.text: The main directions of spatial development of the Russian Federation define specific tasks aimed at overcoming spatial development challenges and problems and realizing opportunities, taking account of the principles of spatial development of the Russian Federation.
